heroSubtitle: Sebenzisa iClaude, iGPT kunye neGemini kwidesktop enye kunye neapp yewebhu, kunye nokufikelela ngokuthe ngqo kwiifayile zakho, ikhowudi kunye neGmail. Faka imali kwiwallet ukusuka kwi-$1 kwaye uhlawule ngesicelo ngasinye.
heroCreditsNotice: {credits} iikredithi zasimahla xa ubhalisa. Faka imali nge-USD okanye i-NGN xa ufuna ngaphezulu.
featureModelsBody: Khetha iClaude, iGPT, iGemini okanye iDeepSeek kwibhokisi yemiyalezo. Yonke impendulo ibonisa ukuba ibize malini.
featureDesktopTitle: Isebenza kumatshini wakho. Ibuza phambi kokuba yenze.
featureDesktopBody: Iapp yedesktop ifunda iifayile zakho kwaye iqhuba imiyalelo kwiiprojekthi zakho. Nantoni na etshintsha into ilindele ukuvunyelwa kwakho.
featureToolsTitle: Ifunda iiPDF zakho, ikhangela kwiwebhu, ijonga ibhokisi yakho ye-imeyile.
featureToolsBody: Hlalutya iingxelo, khangela kwiwebhu, kwaye ubuze ibhokisi yakho ye-imeyile. Izenzo ezibuthathaka zihlala zilindele ukuvunyelwa kwakho.
featurePricingTitle: Hlawula ngento oyisebenzisayo. Akukho nto yimbi.
featurePricingBody: Akukho sicwangciso senyanga. Faka imali xa uthanda kwaye usebenzise iikredithi umyalezo omnye ngexesha.
finalCtaSubtitle: Khuphela iapp okanye uyivule kwisikhangeli sakho. Akukho rhumo lokurhoxisa.
step1Body: Khuphela iapp yedesktop okanye ungene kwiwebhu. Uqala nge-{credits} iikredithi zasimahla.
step2Body: Khetha iClaude, iGPT, iGemini okanye nayiphi na enye imodeli, kwaye utshintshe ingqondo yakho kumyalezo olandelayo.
step3Body: Ncokola, okanye uyikhombise kwiifayile zakho, iiPDF kunye nebhokisi ye-imeyile. Uhlawula kuphela izicelo ozithumelayo.
useCaseWebsite: Yakha iwebhusayithi ngokuthe ngqo kwiPC yakho
useCaseExcel: Hlaziya amaphepha e-Excel ngaphandle kokwazi i-Excel
useCaseMeeting: Guqula amanqaku entlanganiso angacacanga abe yizenzo ezicacileyo
useCaseCode: Bhala kwaye ulungise ikhowudi ngaphandle kobunzima
faqBillingA: Ufaka imali kwiwallet ukusuka kwi-$1 nge-USD okanye i-NGN. Isicelo ngasinye sitsala iindleko zaso, ngokusekelwe kwimodeli oyikhethileyo. Akukho sicwangciso senyanga.
faqModelsA: IClaude, iGPT, iGemini, iDeepSeek, iLlama kunye nezinye, ezihanjiswa nge-OpenRouter. Ungatshintsha iimodeli kuyo nayiphi na imiyalezo.
faqDesktopA: Iifayile zakho zasekhaya kunye neeprojekthi, kunye nemiyalelo oyivunyelayo. Izenzo ezitshintsha into zilindele ukuvunyelwa kwakho kuqala.
faqWebA: Ewe. Ngena kwiwebhu. Iapp yedesktop yongeza ukufikelela kwiifayile zakho zasekhaya kunye neeprojekthi.
faqFreeA: {credits} iikredithi zasimahla zokuyizama, ngaphandle kokurhoxisa urhumo.
footerTagline: Indawo yokusebenza enye kuyo yonke imodeli ephambili. Hlawula ngento oyisebenzisayo.
smartScreenDesc: I-Microsoft Defender SmartScreen ithintele iapp engaziwayo ukuba ingaqali. Ukuqhuba le app kunokubeka iPC yakho emngciphekweni.
windowsIntro: I-AIGenius intsha, ngoko iWindows SmartScreen inokukulumkisa. Nantsi indlela yokuyivula:
freeCreditsNotice: P.S. Ufumana {credits} iikredithi zasimahla xa ubhalisa kwi-app.
demoNoticeWorkspaces: Ukutshintsha iindawo zokusebenza yinxalenye ye-app epheleleyo.
demoNoticeLive: Olu lujongo lokuqala oluphilayo, ngoko ifestile ihlala ikhona.
demoSuggestContract: Shwankathela esi sivumelwano kwaye uphawule nantoni na enobungozi
demoFaUserPrompt: Hlalutya iifolda zam zeprojekthi usebenzisa ii-subagents ezifanayo
demoFaThought: Qala ngokudwelisa ifolda, emva koko uhlukanise uhlalutyo kwii-subagents ukuze nganye ifunde iifolda ezimbalwa ngokufanayo. Yonke into ihlala ifundeka kuphela.
demoFaP2: Makhe ndifumane uluhlu olucacileyo lweefolda kuphela ukuze ndikwazi ukunikezela uhlalutyo ngokufanayo.
demoFaTool3Detail: 6 kwezi-6 zigqityiwe. Funda kuphela: akukho fayile zitshintshiweyo.
demoFaP4: Zonke ii-subagents ezi-6 zigqityiwe (iifolda ezingama-23 zihlalutyiwe, zifundeka kuphela). Nantsi uhlalutyo oludibeneyo.
demoPromptVendor: Shwankathela isivumelwano somthengisi kwaye uphawule nantoni na enobungozi.
demoAllModelsDesc: Khangela kwaye ukhethe kuzo zonke iimodeli ze-AI ezikhoyo. Ukhetho olungagqibekanga luvela kuqala.
demoDesktopPrompt: Cwangcisa ifolda yam yokukhuphela ibe ziifolda ngohlobo.
demoDesktopIntro: Ndiya kuqala ngokujonga ukuba yintoni ekwifolda yakho yokukhuphela.
demoDesktopPlan: Kufunyenwe iifayile ezili-142. Ndiya kuziqokelela zibe ngamaxwebhu, imifanekiso, izifakeli, ii-archives kunye nezinye. Ukuhambisa iifayile kufuna ukuvunyelwa kwakho kuqala.
demoDesktopDone: Kwenziwe. Iifolda ezi-5 zenziwe kwaye iifayile ezili-142 zihanjisiwe. Akukho nto icinyiweyo.
demoToolsPrompt: Shwankathela i-annual-report.pdf, jonga ukuba abakhuphisana nabo bahlawulisa malini, kwaye ufumane i-invoyisi ye-Acme kwi-imeyile yam.
demoToolsAnswerReportBody: ingeniso ikhulile kwaye imida ihlala ingatshintshi.
demoWalletReply1: Isiqendu 7.2 sivumela umthengisi ukuba atshintshe ixabiso ngesaziso seentsuku ezili-14.
demoWalletReply2: Molo Sam, ndijonga nje isindululo. Ndiyavuya ukuphendula nayiphi na imibuzo.
demoWalletReply3: I-loop iqhuba ukuya kwi-arr.length + 1. Yitshintshe ibe yi-arr.length.
demoWalletReply4: I-INV-4021 ishiywe ziintsuku ezili-12. I-INV-4033 ishiywe ziintsuku ezi-5.
demoLinuxModalP1: Okwangoku sixhasa iWindows kwidesktop yemveli, kunye neapp yedesktop yeLinux okwangoku iphuhliswa ngokusebenzayo.
demoLinuxModalP2: Okwangoku, ungasebenzisa i-AIGenius ngamakhono apheleleyo—kubandakanya incoko yeemodeli ezininzi, izincamatheliso zefayile zasekhaya, kunye nezixhobo—ngokuthe ngqo kwisikhangeli sakho sewebhu!
